meta.name: discovery-interview-prep
meta.description: Plan customer discovery interviews with the right goal, segment, constraints, and method. Use when preparing interviews for problem validation, churn research, or new product ideas.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划客户发现访谈的目标、人群与方法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在准备客户访谈来验证问题或探索新想法
copy.tagline_en: Plan customer discovery interviews with goals, segments, and methods
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are preparing customer interviews to validate problems or explore new ideas

howto.what: 它会引导你一步步规划客户发现访谈：先问研究目标、目标客户和限制条件，再推荐访谈方法，最后生成一份包含问题框架、应避免的偏见和成功标准的访谈计划。
howto.when: 当你需要为问题验证、流失研究或新产品创意准备客户发现访谈时触发。例如，你想了解用户为什么流失或验证一个新想法。

say.text: 帮我规划5个企业客户的流失访谈，2周内完成。
say.note: 技能会根据你的目标和限制条件生成访谈计划。

say.text: 我想验证一个新产品的想法，只有2周时间，需要冷启动招募。
say.note: 技能会推荐适合的访谈方法并生成问题框架。

howto.what_en: It guides you step-by-step to plan customer discovery interviews: first asks about research goal, target segment, and constraints, then recommends a methodology, and finally generates an interview plan with question framework, biases to avoid, and success criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to prepare interviews for problem validation, churn research, or new product ideas. For example, you want to understand why users churn or validate a new idea.

say_en.text: Plan 5 enterprise churn interviews within 2 weeks.
say_en.note: The skill will generate an interview plan based on your goal and constraints.

say_en.text: I want to validate a new product idea with a 2-week deadline and cold outreach.
say_en.note: The skill will recommend a methodology and generate a question framework.
